prose: The San Francisco Standard reports that Anthropic's S-1 excludes Ben Mann - billed as 'cofounder Ben Mann' at the company's Singapore office opening two weeks earlier - from its 'Continuing Founders' and the Founder LLC, per a footnote on page 248. That means he is not among the seven founders who will jointly control more than 50.1% of shareholder voting power after the IPO.

Anthropic confirmed there has been no change to Mann's role and said 'it's still fair to refer to him as a cofounder'; his LinkedIn lists him as one. Mann, 37, co-leads Anthropic Labs with Instagram's Mike Krieger, helped develop GPT-3 at OpenAI, and left in 2021 with the seven others who founded Anthropic, citing safety priorities.
highlights: S-1 footnote excludes Ben Mann from Founder LLC and 'Continuing Founders'
Mann publicly billed as cofounder at Singapore office opening on Oct 14
Seven listed founders will control over 50.1% of voting power
Anthropic: no role change; 'still fair to refer to him as a cofounder'
